The demand for optical tester with high-accuracy, high-performance is needed. Optimus device provides to technicians and network managers the optical fiber testers to ensure the performance of their fiber networks. NEW! FTTH Handheld OTDR OTM1100F Handheld OTDR is the latest smart OTDR of Optimus device company. It has features that can satisfy the high requirement from engineer from UK and European countries. – Event type: Connector, splice loss, bending, splitter loss – Wavelength: 1310/1550nm – Dynamic range: 22/20dB – Distance setting: 500m-120km – Pulse width setting range: 3ns-20µs – Event deadzone: 1m – Attenuation deadzone: 6m – Built-in VLS function, OPM function, SLS function, RJ45 test NEW! OTM4000 OTDR Series OTM4000 Optical Time Domain Refl ectometer (OTDR) is an intelligent meter of a new generation for the detection of fi ber communications systems. With the popularization of optical network construction in cities and country sides, the measurement of optical network becomes short and disperse; OTM4000 is specially designed for that kind of application. It’s economic, having outstanding performance – Integrated design, smart and rugged – IP65 protection level, outdoor enhanced – 7-inch anti-refl ection LCD screen – PON online test module (1625nm) is optional – MMF test module (850/1300nm) is optional – Support multi-language display and input – Generate PDF report – Bi-direction trace analysis – Diff erential trace analysis NEW! OTDR MULTI TESTER All Functions in 1 Device, Pocket-sized, Easy-to-use, and Affordable for Technicians at any Level The device is with 3.5 inch Capacitive LCD screen, supporting both touch and physical buttons operation. It can be charged by Type-C USB. Wireless charging is optional. With new automatic laser detection technology, optical modules can be protected to be damaged when light (up to -2dBm) is running on the testing fiber.
